Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a â€œWHITEâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.

CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Approval of the Minutes of the May 31, 2017 Regular Meeting, June 27, 2017 12:00PM Special Meeting, June 27, 2017 6:00PM Special Meeting, June 28, 2017 Regular Meeting, June 28, 2017 4:00PM Special Budget Meeting, and June 28, 2017 Special Meeting Closed Session. 8C.
Designation of a voting delegate and voting delegate-alternates for the League of California Cities (LCC) Annual Conference, September 13-15, 2017 and cancelation of the September 13 Regular City Council Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Adopt Resolution 2017-54 designating Council Member Boerner Horvath to represent the City of Encinitas as a voting delegate and Council Member Mosca as voting delegate-alternate at the LCC Annual Conference to be held September 13-15, 2017 in Sacramento; and 2) Approve the cancelation of the September 13, 2017 Regular City Council Meeting.
2017-08-09 Item 08C League Of California Cities Voting Delegate (LCC)
8D.
Introduction of Ordinance 2017-10 amending Section 2.30.020.E.1 of the Encinitas Municipal Code regarding Commissioner attendance requirements. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Introduce Ordinance 2017-10 titled â€œAn Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Amending Section 2.30.020.E.1 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Regarding Commissioner Attendance Requirements;â€ and direct staff to not remove Tomoko Kuta from the Commission for the Arts.
2017-08-09 Item 08D Ordinance 2017-10 Commissioner Attendance
8E.
Construction Contract for the 2017-18 Citywide Sewer Rehabilitation Project (CC04E and CE04H). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Hefner
1) Authorize the Interim City Engineer, or his designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract with Nuline Technologies in the amount of $1,318,952.50 plus 15% contingencies to construct the 2017-2018 Citywide Sewer Rehabilitation Project, for a total contract amount not to exceed $1,516,796; 2) Authorize the Interim City Engineer, or his designee, in coordination with the City Attorney to amend Nuline Technologiesâ€™ contract to extend completion dates if necessary; and 3) Authorize the Interim City Engineer, or his designee, in coordination with the City Attorney to execute a contract amendment, and any necessary extensions, with Geopacifica in the amount of $59,750 plus 15% contingencies to perform inspection and material testing services for the 2017-2018 Citywide Sewer Rehabilitation Project, for a total FY2017-2018 contract amount not to exceed $1,158,224.
2017-08-09 Item 08E Final Complete Sewer Rehabilitation Construction Award
8F.
Appointments to the Environmental Commission and the Traffic and Public Safety Commission (New Encinitas representative) to fill unscheduled vacancies. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Approve the Mayor's recommendation to appoint Christina Simokat to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission (New Encinitas representative) with a term ending March 2020 to fill one unscheduled vacancy created by the resignation of Maryam Babaki. Christina Simokat is currently an Environmental Commissioner. Appointing her to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission creates an unscheduled vacancy on the Environmental Commission; and 2) Approve the Mayor's recommendation to appoint Christian S. Adams and Inge Bisconer to the Environmental Commission with terms ending March 2018 to fill the unscheduled vacancies created by Leah Bissonette' s resignation and the Mayor's recommendation to appoint Christina Simokat to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission.
2017-08-09 Item 08F Environmental and Traffic and Public Safety Commission Appointments - REDACTED
8G.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2017-08, titled â€œAn Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting an amendment to Title 9 (Public Safety, Peace, and Welfare) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to add Chapter 9.27 (Deemed Approved Alcoholic Beverage Serving Establishments) for the purpose of protecting the public safety, peace, and welfare of the community by requiring all alcoholic beverage serving establishments authorized for retail sale of alcoholic beverages for on-site consumption in the City to comply with nuisance-based performance standards.â€ CASE NO: 17-110 ZA; LOCATION: Citywide. Contact Person: Associate Planner Winter
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2017-08, titled â€œAn Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting an amendment to Title 9 (Public Safety, Peace, and Welfare) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to add Chapter 9.27 (Deemed Approved Alcoholic Beverage Serving Establishments) for the purpose of protecting the public safety, peace, and welfare of the community by requiring all alcoholic beverage serving establishments authorized for retail sale of alcoholic beverages for on-site consumption in the City to comply with nuisance-based performance standardsâ€.
2017-08-09 Item 08G Second Reading of Ordinance No. 2017-08 Amendment to Title 9
8H.
Assignment of Coffee Cart License Agreement at the Encinitas Library. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
That Council gives the City Manager authority to exercise the assignment clause in the coffee cart licensing agreement at the Encinitas Library.
2017-08-09 Item 08H Encinitas Library Coffee Cart Licensing Agreement
8I.
Legislative Position Letters. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the legislative position letters, as signed by the Deputy Mayor.
2017-08-09 Item 08I Legislative Position Letters
8J.
Budget Adjustment for Design Review of Mobility Projects. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2017-62 entitled, â€œA Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2017-18 Adopted Budgetâ€ authorizing an additional appropriation of $50,000 for contractual services provided by Dan Burden.
2017-08-09 Item 08J Adopt Resolution No. 2017-62 Regarding Design Review of Mobility Projects and Contractual Services Provided by Dan Burden
8K.
B Street Pedestrian Improvements. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Kellar
1) Authorize the City Engineer, or his designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to approve all contracts and amendments to contracts for the project, including for the lowest responsible and responsive bidder, specialists, and professional services, as necessary to complete the project within a total not-to-exceed project budget of $45,000 including 15% contingency for the project; and 2) Authorize the City Engineer to prohibit parking on B Street from Second Street to the alley immediately west of Highway 101.
2017-08-09 Item 08K B Street Pedestrian Improvements
8L.
Amend Agreement with Los Angeles Printers Inc. dba printingCEO for Graphic Design, Print Layout, Printing and Bulk Mail Preparation Services for the Recreation Guide Publication. Contact Person: Special Events and Special Projects Supervisor Buck
Authorize the City Manager to approve an agreement amendment, adding a fourth (4th) issue to the Estimated Recreation Guide Production Timeline.
2017-08-09 Item 08L Los Angeles Printers DBA PrintingCEO Contract Amendment
8M.
Purchase of replacement playground equipment for Encinitas Viewpoint Park and Mildred Macpherson Park. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
Approve the purchase of playground equipment from Playcraft Systems through the National Intergovernmental Purchasing Alliance Contract #R170304 in the amount of $128,280 for Encinitas Viewpoint Park and Mildred Macpherson Park.
2017-08-09 Item 08M Encinitas Viewpoint Point Park and Mildred Macpherson Park Playground Equipment Purchase
8N.
Construction Contract for the Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY2017-2018 (CS18A). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Hefner
1) Authorize the City Engineer, or his designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract with PAL General Engineering in the amount of $2,676,078 plus 15% contingencies, and $250,000 striping contingencies to construct the Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY2017-2018, for a total contract amount not to exceed $3,327,490; and 2) Authorize the Interim City Engineer, or his designee, to amend PAL General Engineeringâ€™s contract to extend completion dates if necessary; and 3) Authorize the Interim City Engineer, or his designee, to execute a contract amendment, and any necessary extensions, with Geopacifica in the amount of $45,425 plus 15% contingencies to perform inspection and material testing services for the Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY2017-2018, for a total contract amount not to exceed $1,210,462.25, which is below the contract cost cap of $1,500,000.
2017-08-09 Item 08N Construction Contract Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY2017-2018
8O.
Assignment agreement with North County Transit District (NCTD) for Harbaugh Seaside Parkway. Contact Person: Assistant City Manager Delin
Authorize the City Manager to execute an assignment agreement with NCTD to assume responsibility for the Harbaugh Seaside Parkway (formerly Carpentier Parkway) and adopt the attached resolution amending the Fiscal Year 2017-2018 Operating and Capital Budget.
2017-08-09 Item 08O Assignment agreement with North County Transit District (NCTD) for Harbaugh Seaside Parkway

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
